carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single longitudinal ridge is clearly visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a light-colored dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge, running parallel to the body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a low density of high-luminance spots, primarily clustered along the lower half of the fin's leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: Several smaller teleost fish are visible in close proximity to the subject: one near the rostrum, one near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin, and others along the ventral margin.
